mutant.lineText: for (const u of [cfg.acsUrl, cfg.idp.ssoUrl]) if (!/^https:\/\/|^http:\/\/localhost[:/]/.test(u)) throw new SamlError('config', `${u} must be an https URL`);
mutant.nextText: if (!cfg.idp.certificates.length) throw new SamlError('config', 'the IdP needs at least one pinned certificate');
